custodians.name: Tianjin Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau / Jizhou district planning and natural-resources administration
custodians.scope: Official Tianjin bureau material evidences Jizhou land and building real-estate registration notices; Tianjin Tianditu is the public geographic-information platform operated under the bureau.

requests.outcome: TLS certificate expired; request stopped before HTTP. No verification bypass used.
Official documentation identifies vector, imagery, terrain, place/address and real-estate-registration thematic services; no parcel schema or geometry response obtained.
Official Jizhou map/download page identified; cartographic map material only, with no safe parcel feature response.
Official bureau search result/page evidences current Jizhou real-estate registration notices; no parcel API or geometry returned.
Official registration standard inspected for cadastral terminology and scope; no public Jizhou parcel geometry endpoint.

queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese first-party discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-9294-jizhou.json. They identified Tianjin Tianditu, the municipal planning/natural-resources bureau, and Jizhou registration notices, but did not qualify anonymous parcel geometry access.

schemaAndCrs.note: No parcel layer metadata or feature response was returned.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [40.0440289221055, 117.398748171146] was preserved and not shifted.
No certificate failure, unavailable viewer, map extent miss, timeout, or lack of an exact-point response was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
No parcel polygon is retained because no safe native identity plus full geometry was returned.

Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: The current Tianjin Tianditu frontend/API route and whether its cadastral-registration thematic layer exposes safe anonymous parcel geometry remain unresolved because the base host failed TLS verification.
Parcel coverage, native identity semantics, field mapping, CRS, and citywide completeness remain unverified.
